title: E-FND-0091: the domain wall is a projective measurement of the clock class with counting weights: over an exhaustive...
purpose: Experiment E-FND-0091 in the foundations arena: the domain wall is a projective measurement of the clock class with counting weights: over an exhaustive 75-seed ensemble at side 9 the wall amplifies offset-2 defects (72 of 75, three slot-level exceptions, one an exact annihilation) and leaves every offset-0, 1 and 3 defect at exactly sqrt 3, confirmed at side 11 at its own post-onset beat, and the response to two and three separated amplifying defects is the exact sum of the singles (deviating only when the clusters touch), so the base has the definite outcome and the phase selection while the Born quadratic weight cannot arise: defects occupy one clock class each and the detector adds counts.
known_limitations: Depth L3 (L3: one base rule produced the result as a measured consequence, with a computed control that could have failed).
